create_tensorboard_writer: create a TensorboardWriter instance from a config object to log training metrics to Tensorboard
add_scalars_to_tensorboard: add multiple scalar values from a dictionary to Tensorboard logs with an optional global step
plot_confusion_matrix: plot a confusion matrix from predictions and labels and log it to Tensorboard for evaluation
visualize_weights_activations: visualize model weights or activations tensors as heatmap images in Tensorboard with optional normalization
add_heatmap_to_tensor: add a viridis colormap heatmap to a 2D tensor and return the resulting 3D tensor
